title: One FlexLine at a Time: Customer Holding Rule
content:
A customer may hold 1 FlexLine at a time — one line under FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.

## Clause

A line in applied, active, frozen or repayment status blocks a new application, while a declined, closed or charged-off line does not. The customer has no other FlexLine in applied, active, frozen or repayment status. A customer whose earlier line was charged off cannot open a new one until that balance is paid or settled.

The condition is read from Larkspur's own records of the customer's FlexLine lines, before the application is taken, and it concerns lines held under the same customer.

## Status of an earlier FlexLine and its effect on a new application

| Status of the customer's other FlexLine | Blocks a new application |
|---|---|
| applied | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| frozen | Yes |
| repayment | Yes |
| declined | No |
| closed | No |
| charged off | No, but a new line cannot be opened until the charged-off balance is paid or settled |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer whose only earlier FlexLine shows closed may apply for a new one.
- A customer with a FlexLine in repayment, even with a small remaining balance, cannot have a second FlexLine application taken.
- A customer whose earlier FlexLine was charged off and whose balance has since been settled is not blocked by that line; while that balance is neither paid nor settled, a new line cannot be opened.
